transcript:
assistant: ನಮಸ್ಕಾರ, ನಾನು Sanjeevani ಪರವಾಗಿ ಮಾತನಾಡುತ್ತಿದ್ದೇನೆ. Am I speaking with the supplies team?
user: Yes, this is the right number. Tell me.
assistant: We have an urgent requirement — precision castings, five hundred units. Our regular supplier has a delay. Can you confirm availability this week?
user: Five hundred units — yes, we have stock. We can do it.
assistant: Good. What unit price can you offer for five hundred units?
user: For that quantity, one hundred and ninety-five rupees per unit.
assistant: Our budget is tighter — we have worked at one eighty before. Can you do one eighty-five for a confirmed order today?
user: One eighty-five is very low. One hundred and eighty-nine, final. Delivery in two days.
assistant: One hundred and eighty-nine per unit, delivery within two days — confirmed. Payment on delivery via UPI. Please share your UPI ID.
user: vishwakarma.castings@ybl. Send the PO on WhatsApp.
assistant: Done. You will receive the purchase order shortly. Thank you.
summary: Vendor confirmed availability of 500 units at Rs 189 per unit with 2-day delivery, payment on delivery via UPI.
